Lemma
[The fundamental solution is harmonic away from the origin]

↗ def:fundamental-solution-laplace ↗ def:harmonic-function

1. ch2:2.2.1-lem-1\group Fundamental Solutions

For every $x e 0$, $\Delta \Phi (x)=0$.
Proof

\sketch Write $\Phi (x)=g(|x|^2)$. The chain rule gives

\[ \Delta \Phi (x)=4|x|^2g''(|x|^2)+2n g'(|x|^2). \]

Substitution of $g( ho )=-(4\pi )^{-1}\log ho $ for $n=2$ or $g( ho )=[n(n-2)\alpha (n)]^{-1} ho ^{(2-n)/2}$ for $n\ge 3$ makes this expression vanish.

□

The radial formula also yields, for a constant $C>0$, \[ (7)\qquad |D\Phi (x)|\le rac{C}{|x|^{n-1}}, \qquad |D^2\Phi (x)|\le rac{C}{|x|^n} \quad (x e 0). \]
